name: Tokenised GBP
oneLiner: tGBP is BCP Technologies' UK-FCA-registered pound stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against GBP reserves and short UK government paper.
collateral: GBP reserves held in regulated financial institutions and/or backed by short-term UK government paper.
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through BCP Technologies Ltd; clients deposit GBP off-chain and receive minted tGBP on-chain; redemption burns tokens and triggers fiat withdrawal

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: tGBP resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: tGBP is a UUPS-upgradeable OFT token (StableTokenV1OFT) by BCP Technologies whose owner can mint and burn; minting occurs once an equivalent GBP deposit is verified off-chain by the team, with no separate role-gated minter.

controls.label: StableTokenV1OFT owner (mint/burn + upgrade authority)
controls.evidence: Per the OpenZeppelin audit, the owner of the StableTokenV1OFT contract can mint and burn tokens (no separate MINTER role) and holds UUPS upgrade authority; Ethereum owner() returned 0xAF4fCE2984Fb307a368f3Ff01f900909956595C0 and cast code returned 0x.

review.evidence: OpenZeppelin's audit of BCP Technologies' tGBP (StableTokenV1OFT) confirms a single owner controls mint and burn with UUPS upgradeability and no separate minter role; minting is gated on off-chain GBP deposit verification. This is owner-gated permissioned minting rather than a pure backend-only model.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Owner-controlled mint/burn and UUPS upgradeability confirmed from the OpenZeppelin audit; live Ethereum owner read resolved to an EOA.
